provenance: List prices per million tokens at DeepSeek-R1's API launch (Jan 2025): R1 $0.55 input (cache miss) / $2.19 output, vs OpenAI o1 $15 input / $60 output — a ~27x (~96%) reduction on both meters (60/2.19 = 27.4; 15/0.55 = 27.3). points encode the output-price bars (x=0: o1, x=1: R1; y = $/M output tokens). r1RlTrainUSD is the one-time RL-stage training cost DeepSeek reported in the Nature version of the R1 paper (~$294,000 on 512 H800s); it EXCLUDES the ~$6M base-model (V3) pretraining bill and is used in-app only as an order-of-magnitude anchor for a one-time retraining/distillation run. Vendor-published prices, not peer-reviewed; flagged in-app.
